Module.Name: gaia-iml
Module.Description: Gaia DR3 variable star detection and classification using IntegratedML Custom Models + AI Hub. Scans 20 gzipped epoch photometry files, ingests flux and per-epoch quality stats into IRIS, then scores every source with SQL PREDICT() against three custom IRISModels: two NGBoost regressors predicting ESA's own epoch reject fraction and its uncertainty, and a HistGradientBoosting classifier predicting variable-star type from 27 light-curve features (macro F1 0.938 over nine classes, labels from gaiadr3.vari_classifier_result). ~11s end-to-end for the contest path. Where the classifier disagrees with the published DR3 label, a three-stage adjudicator settles what centroid distance and clustering can settle, then asks an AI Hub agent to weigh the published literature from SIMBAD -- with the Gaia-derived classifications filtered out, because SIMBAD re-publishes them. InterSystems Employee Programming Challenge #1. The optional recursive-language-model reports (^RLMAudit, ^RLMTriage, ^RLM2Audit) run on rlm-core: Gaia.Source declares the survey as an RLM.Source -- six dimensions, 22 slices, sixteen aggregates -- and the library supplies the recursion, the budget, the slice resolver and the report.
